notes.title: Our next game: Release Date Confirmed for the metroidvania Dimensional Animals!
notes.content:
[h1]Release date SET![/h1]

Hello, guys! Marcos here. I'm the main developer behind Super Forklift 3000.

I'm here to announce our next release: DIMENSIONAL ANIMALS!

This metroidvania adventure filled with action, exploration and retro goodness will release on [b]June 5th, 2024![/b]

We are [b]just a few weeks away[/b] from its release. Hope you're excited!

The game will release at a fair price and I'll also bring in a very juicy release discount! So hopefully I can count on you to get your copy right as the game releases, on June 5th!

[h1]But I want to play NOW![/h1]

Don't worry, because while you wait for the full release of the game, I have launched an [b]updated version of the demo[/b] allowing for a bit more of exploration!

You can download it now on Dimensional Animal's steam page.

Please also tell your friends about it and ask them to play the demo too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344060/Dimensional_Animals/

Thanks for hearing the news! I'm on full steam here to make the best experience possible!

See you soon!

[i]Special thanks to all members of the Dimensional Animals development team:
- Hugo Andrade on pixel art
- Malu Colusso on music
- Jonas Siebeneichler on sound effects[/i]

notes.title: Summer Update: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
Hey! Marcos here, bringing you another Super Forklift 3000 update!

To celebrate the Steam [b]Summer Sale[/b], we're giving a [b]20% discount[/b] on Super Forklift 3000, and a [b]new game mode![/b]

[b]BOSS RUSH![/b]

Every game with bosses is expected to have a boss rush mode, so Super Forklift 3000 now has it!

In order to play it, just select the Boss Rush mode in the Play menu.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YSTghaklLJVVGOkGzJ/giphy.gif[/img]

Every achievement is blocked in this game mode, except for the one called [i]Cristiane[/i] that asks you to defeat a boss in 40 seconds or less. You can use this mode to unlock this achievement faster by going straight to the boss fights!

This mode is exactly what the name says. Instead of playing the whole levels, you fight only the bosses, and fight them in a row.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/IgF4rwjROJkpWcWdPB/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]I've hidden the last boss from the gif above to not spoil it.[/i]

Give it a go! Hope you can beat all bosses!

If you still don't own Super Forklift 3000, get it during the Summer Sale for a 20% discount!

Thanks for reading and for the continuous support to my beloved game!

Have fun!
